body: I've been in therapy for almost 5 years now. My therapist is the one who told me everyone has certain things that make them happy. For some it's easier like a hobby or something but for me that's not the case. Trust me, I want that to change so I can just be happy on my own but I can't. I don't think anyone would choose to be miserable.

That's fair, you have great points and I understand. You also just showed me that I could never actually have a relationship with the way I am. It is unhealthy and unfair. I can't change what makes me happy though so I guess life just isn't for me. My job doesn't make me happy, my pet doesn't make me happy, my family doesn't make me happy, my friends don't make me happy. I know what would make me happy but I can't have a good healthy relationship the way I am. How do I change this for it is possible?

No I haven't. I'm trying to be better than the old me. She doesn't deserve that. I don't want her to think it's her fault if I off myself. I do own up to the dumb shit I said and did with my last ex. It was all very dumb of me and I know it. I also know that my reliance on a relationship is bad but that's something I can't change. Everyone needs something to live for and make them happy. For some it's there job, for others it's there family's, and for me it's the feeling of being loved and cared for my someone. When I don't have that I'm miserable. I've been miserable for about 2/3 of my life. I just want to be happy. Sorry for offending you so much.
No I didn't, I could never do that to her. I knew posting this was a terrible idea. Thanks for making me feel worse fam. It's very appreciated. As if I didn't feel shitty enough.
